title: PATCH 1.0.6.8.4 — PATCH NOTES
content:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PATCH 1.0.6.8.4 — PATCH NOTES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Patch 1.0.6.8.4 introduces additional spell restorations, enchantment balancing and custom progression requirements for the Naxxramas server.

The update focuses on restoring earlier class mechanics, adjusting the crafting requirements of Enchant Weapon — Crusader and introducing a new progression requirement for Dire Maul.

The main changes include:

• Increased material requirements for Enchant Weapon — Crusader.
• A new custom progression key and matching lock for Dire Maul.
• The introduction of the custom Warlock spell Wrack.
• Restoration of Rockbiter Weapon Ranks 1–7.
• Additional spell effects supporting Rockbiter's Attack Power and threat mechanics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# ENCHANTMENT CHANGES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# Enchant Weapon — Crusader

Enchant Weapon — Crusader has received a significant adjustment to its material requirements.

Crusader is one of the strongest weapon enchantments available during Vanilla progression.

To better reflect its strength and endgame value, the materials required to perform the enchantment have been increased.

Previous requirements:

• 4 Large Brilliant Shards.
• 2 Righteous Orbs.

New requirements:

• 10 Large Brilliant Shards.
• 6 Righteous Orbs.
• 1 Nexus Crystal.

This increases the investment required to produce the enchantment while retaining its existing combat effects.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# DIRE MAUL PROGRESSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# Dire Maul — Custom Progression Key

A new custom key-and-lock progression system has been introduced for Dire Maul.

The purpose of this change is to make Dire Maul part of the server's intended raid and dungeon progression rather than allowing immediate access to the gated content.

The new system includes:

• A custom progression key.
• A matching custom lock.
• A progression requirement associated with Onyxia.

Players must reach the appropriate Onyxia progression point and obtain the required custom key before the matching Dire Maul lock can be opened.

This introduces an additional progression milestone and helps maintain the intended order in which higher-level Vanilla content becomes accessible.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# WARLOCK CHANGES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# Wrack — New Warlock Spell

A new custom Warlock spell has been introduced:

Wrack

Wrack is associated with the Affliction talent Shadow Mastery.

Warlocks who invest fully into Shadow Mastery, reaching Rank 5/5, become eligible to learn Wrack.

This provides an additional custom spell for Warlocks specialising in Affliction.

Wrack is included in the Naxxramas custom spell data rather than being part of the original World of Warcraft 3.3.5a spell collection.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# SHAMAN CHANGES:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# Rockbiter Weapon — Restoration

Rockbiter Weapon has received a substantial restoration.

The restoration covers the original seven-rank progression and returns Rockbiter towards its earlier Vanilla-style functionality.

Rockbiter Weapon is designed to provide:

• Rank-based melee Attack Power.
• Additional threat from successful melee auto-attacks.

This replaces the later Wrath of the Lich King-style weapon damage bonus with the earlier Attack Power-based design.

The restored rank chain includes:

• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 1.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 2.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 3.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 4.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 5.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 6.
• Rockbiter Weapon Rank 7.

──────────────────────────────────

# Rockbiter Weapon — Attack Power

The restored Rockbiter Weapon system uses additional custom spell effects to provide the appropriate rank-based melee Attack Power.

Each of the seven Rockbiter ranks has a corresponding hidden Attack Power helper spell.

These supporting effects allow Rockbiter to provide its restored Attack Power benefits while retaining the existing weapon enchantment system.

──────────────────────────────────

# Rockbiter Weapon — Threat Generation

An additional hidden spell has been introduced to support Rockbiter Weapon's restored threat generation.

The effect supports additional melee threat when attacking enemies with Rockbiter active.

This helps restore the earlier identity of Rockbiter Weapon as an offensive weapon enhancement with additional threat generation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# SpellItemEnchantment.dbc

SpellItemEnchantment.dbc has deliberately been left unchanged.

The restored Rockbiter system continues using the existing weapon enchantment records.

Additional custom spell effects provide the required Attack Power and threat functionality.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
# PATCH 1.0.6.8.4 — BRIEF SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Patch 1.0.6.8.4 introduces additional class spell restorations, enchantment balancing and progression requirements.

Enchant Weapon — Crusader now requires additional crafting materials, including a Nexus Crystal, to better reflect its strength during Vanilla progression.

Dire Maul has received a custom progression key and matching lock associated with Onyxia progression.

Warlocks gain access to the custom Wrack spell through Shadow Mastery Rank 5/5.

Shamans receive the restored Rockbiter Weapon rank chain, including custom Attack Power and additional melee threat effects.

These changes expand the Naxxramas custom client spell data while supporting the server's intended Vanilla progression experience.
